$comment: The sample install's older history: Done tasks behind the archived ones, each with one real headless Claude run (scripts/capture-demo-archived-runs.mjs) that the Knowledge Graph indexes. The upstream samples' tasks are their own merged commits, each run at that commit's parent so the work is real; contoso-web has no upstream history, so its tasks were drafted and reviewed. Archive dates spread from the day after each project was added to the install (at most 90 days back) to four days ago, oldest commits oldest. model and effort are the runs'.
